sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238729
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 54081 of 2023

Applicant :- Rinku
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Akhilesh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajiv Dhar Dwivedi, learned Aga for
the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
246 of 2023, under Sections 452, 504, 506, 354-B, 376 IPC, Police Station Chharra, District Aligarh,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.
3.

FIR of the present case was lodged on 8.7.2023 against the applicant under sections 452, 504,
506, 354-B IPC and according to the FIR on 14.6.2023 applicant after entering in the house of the informant who is a married lady outraged her modesty and when after hearing her shriek her Jethani-Meena arrived then he ran away.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegations he has been made accused in the present matter and neither in the FIR nor in the statement of the informant recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C. there was any allegation of rape but when the statement of the Rinku vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160165736/
1 victim was recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. then first time she stated that applicant committed rape upon her.
5.

He further submitted that in the statement recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. victim also introduced one another accused and all these facts clearly suggests that on the basis of false allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

6. He further submitted that actually applicant and victim both were having illicit relationship but at the time of their intimate hours when Jethani of the informant arrived then FIR of the present case was lodged by the informant only under the pressure of her family members.
7.
He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.8.2023.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that informant i.e. victim of the case is a married and major lady and FIR of the present case was lodged after almost three weeks of the alleged incident.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. informant i.e. victim of the case made allegation of rape against the applicant and one another but no allegation of rape was made by her in the FIR or in the statement recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C.

11. Further admittedly, victim i.e. informant of the case is married and major lady and FIR of the present case was lodged after more than 20 days, therefore, defence taken by the applicant cannot be completely brushed aside at this stage.
12. Further, applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 16.8.2023.

13. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
14. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

15. Let the applicant-Rinku, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
Rinku vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160165736/
2

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
16. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

17. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
